note: Free/open data providers for the Backlink Prospector. Mirrors seo-page-snapshot's provider model: no paid API is ever required. enabled=false skips a provider. Commercial metrics (DR/DA) are NEVER estimated; they are emitted as status:unavailable with a reason. ${VAR} placeholders are expanded from the environment at request time and are never written to disk.

providers.name: Curated real prospect seed library (no network)
providers.license: Manually verified public sites; audit before outreach.
providers.metric_note: Real, manually-verified backlink prospects across types. Always live-validated at analyze time.
providers.note: Backbone of 'real and valid' results. No API key, no network.

providers.name: Bing web search (free, no API key, HTML parse)
providers.license: Bing results; respect ToS. Best-effort discovery only.
providers.metric_note: Discovers live prospect URLs per niche keyword x type template; real URLs are recovered from b_algo redirect wrappers (base64 u= param).
providers.note: Free real-time discovery. Degrades gracefully to seed-only if blocked.

providers.name: Tranco daily popularity rank (free, no API key)
providers.metric_note: A popularity RANK is not a backlink count or DR. Used only as a free trust signal; mapped onto tranco_global_rank, never onto commercial DR/DA.
providers.note: Free authority signal. domain_rating (DR/DA) stays unavailable.

providers.name: Local backlink export (CSV) for true gap diff
providers.metric_note: Operator-supplied data (e.g. Google Search Console links report, free-tier Ahrefs/SEMrush export, or a self-hosted Common Crawl web-graph export). No network request is made. Domains here mark already_have=true, turning the prospect list into a real gap diff.
providers.note: Paste a CSV/text of existing referring domains (one per line) to compute the true gap. Mirrors seo-page-snapshot local_backlinks_csv.
